findings.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was a record $34.0 million, up 126% year over year and 19% sequentially; GAAP gross margin was 27% (vs 20% in Q1 2026); net loss attributable to common stockholders was $5.1 million including a $1.9 million non-cash warrant modification charge.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights

findings.claim: Amprius raised 2026 revenue guidance to at least $140 million (from at least $130 million) and gross margin to at least 28% (from 25%); it reiterated adjusted EBITDA of at least $4.0 million and capex under $10 million.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights

findings.claim: Hitting the $140M floor requires ~$77.5M in H2 2026 (~$39M/quarter) vs Q3 consensus of ~$35.8M, and full-year consensus (~$133M per Finviz article) sits below the guidance floor; shares fell >32% since the Q2 report.
findings.source_title: Amprius Must Prove Its Second-Half Ramp As Stock Lags Its Raised $140 Million Outlook

findings.claim: Amprius received a $24 million order from a new European drone manufacturer for SiCore cylindrical cells, with deliveries starting Q2 2026 and running through Q1 2027.

Management said about half of the 19 drone makers invited to the Drone Dominance Gauntlet II event used Amprius cells; Redwire (customer for Stalker Block 30) announced >$40M of U.S. Marine Corps purchase orders.

The Defense Innovation Unit contract to develop and scale NDAA-compliant silicon anode cells was increased a third time to $18.1 million, funding a Fremont pilot line with production expected to begin December 2026.

The FY2026 NDAA includes new battery sourcing restrictions for U.S. government suppliers; Amprius uses South Korean contract manufacturers (Libest, JR Energy, Top Material) for NDAA-compliant supply today and Nanotech Energy for U.S. capacity, and says it will be fully NDAA compliant in 2027-2028.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Amprius has historically relied on China-based contract manufacturing partners and formed a China sales subsidiary in January 2025; its 10-Q flags tariff and China regulatory risk. Transition costs to a U.S./allied supply chain could pressure margins.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Amprius completed its $100 million ATM program, issuing 25.5 million shares in aggregate for ~$97.5 million net; ~$19.6 million was sold in Q4 2025 at an average $11.17/share. The company stated it has no ATM program currently.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies, Inc. Form 8-K filed January 12, 2026

findings.claim: In Q2 2026 Amprius exchanged 7,128,458 public warrants ($11.50 strike) for 2,726,631 common shares, which management framed as cutting dilution vs. full warrant exercise; remaining warrants expire September 14, 2027.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Cash and equivalents were $74.5 million at June 30, 2026, which management believes is sufficient for 12 months; receivables rose to $40.7 million on back-end-loaded shipments.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2026

findings.claim: Insiders sold 123,311 shares worth about $1.27 million over the 90 days before Nov 3, 2026; shares traded ~$8.86 vs a 12-month high of $24.23.
findings.source_title: Amprius Technologies (AMPX) Projected to Announce Quarterly Earnings on Tuesday

findings.claim: Amprius states its silicon anode cells deliver up to twice the energy density of conventional graphite-based batteries, targeting aviation, drones and HAPS; customers include AeroVironment, BAE Systems, Teledyne FLIR and the U.S. Army.
